title: Planet Tweaks V2.8.1 NOVA TITAN 🪐 — Flawless Window Maximize, Unlocked Crosshair Scrolling & Zero-Delay Input Engine
releaseNotes: Seamless Window Maximization: Dynamically eliminates border radius on maximize so desktop wallpaper never bleeds through edges. Unlocked Custom Crosshair Studio: Resolved layout scroll deadlocks for silky smooth preset and slider configuration. Rock-Solid Game Overlay: Reinforced Win32 HWND_TOPMOST priority and disabled activation so the crosshair reticle never hides or drops behind fullscreen DirectX esports titles. Persistent GamerTag Priority: Guaranteed your custom gamer tag stays locked in across cloud and local sessions. Zero-Delay Input Tweaks: Added Zero Keyboard Bounce Lockout (0ms) and Disable Mouse ClickLock to ensure rapid build, edit, and click sequences never hitch.
